checks.title: Inspect live conversation timeline
checks.instructions: After automated UI/runtime QA passes, open the live Transcript/Debug view during a real voice session. Verify User is readable on the left, Jarvis/Mouth is light blue, Brain is orange, sub-agent spans are red, overlaps/durations are understandable, and clicking non-user events opens useful details/trace links.
checks.expected: The timeline is readable during a real conversation, preserves temporal overlap, and provides useful drill-down without exposing hidden reasoning.
